rationales.topology_prior: A symmetric exact prior gives the three declared interaction structures equal prior opportunity.
rationales.mandate_support: Pilot-attainable weak, moderate, and strong finite levels make mandate recovery identifiable without a continuous approximation.
rationales.outcome_level_support: Three normalized success baselines span adverse, ambiguous, and favorable shared outcomes.
rationales.registration_reliability: A finite 0.9 channel yields a material relational update while preserving bounded evidence and exact masking neutrality.
rationales.joint_policy_inverse_temperature: A finite temperature retains positive mass on every ordinary joint policy while allowing reliable cost orderings.
rationales.shared_outcome_weight: The prior-predictive range includes both negligible and material cross-policy effects without adding a polarization term.
rationales.recovery_length: Prospective exchangeability-corrected pilots found that 486 observations were needed to place topology recovery stably above .80 and suppress residual false cross-coupling; each three-protector joint policy is exposed eighteen times.
